main_text.l: strum 893, vocat sextum Semittæ, sed in
Judæis anno 894 demum in Succoth iniit.
Ergo ne Samaritani à Judæis anno soli-
dæ, quem Cunæus citat, Sabbaticos ac
mox post quatriduum à סכות Succoth J-
mus; certe anno 888 inierit annus à Ju-
tus & v. anno 893, septimus in Semitta
sextus γεωργίας, atque ad eum modum
Jubilaicum omnino simulq; Semittam, hoc est

page.notes: The printed page number reads "341"; the final digit may be an old-style 1 and is copied as 341. The Hebrew words כפורים and סכות and the Greek γεωργίας (twice, once split as γεωρ-γίας) are copied from the scan; their exact letter forms are not fully certain. The ampersand in "&" is the printed ampersand. Some lines are set with long s, which is transcribed as plain s.
